biggest_catch: Flat $125 per day for a 14.5-hour day (6:00am-8:30pm); required training is paid but the board's training rate is not published.
catches: Election-period work only (Van Wert County, OH).
Must be a qualified elector registered to vote in Van Wert County.
Must complete the required training (paid at a board-determined rate; amount not published, so training is excluded from the numeric figures).
No felony conviction or election-law violation; must read and write English readily; cannot be a precinct candidate.
Duties include opening/closing polls and overseeing ballot casting all day.

steps: Be a qualified elector registered to vote in Van Wert County.
Contact the Election Board Office ((419) 238-4192) for information and assignment.
Complete the required training program (reimbursed at a board-determined rate).
Serve Election Day 6:00am to 8:30pm: receive ballots/supplies, open/close polls, oversee casting.
